companyDescription: AI Data Center Networking · High-speed connectivity silicon (AEC cables, SerDes, line card chips) enabling hyperscaler AI clusters — the bandwidth backbone of AI infrastructure
priceNote: Up to ~$276 after Jul 2 semi bounce; still below Stifel $350/BofA $340 targets. Q1 FY27 earnings Sep 9 — guided $465-475M revenue.
summary: Credo Technology trades at $276 after a sector bounce, still below analyst targets (avg $270 near current; Stifel $350, Evercore $340). Q4 FY26 delivered $437M revenue (+157% YoY) with Q1 FY27 guide $465-475M. FY26 full-year revenue $1.34B tripled YoY. Next earnings Sep 9, 2026. AI data center AEC/optical connectivity demand remains the structural driver — but at ~96x P/E, continued beat-and-raise is required.

catalysts.name: Hyperscaler AI Fabric Expansion
catalysts.description: Microsoft, Google, Amazon are building 100GbE+ AI cluster interconnects — Credo's Active Electrical Cables (AEC) and line card chips are the key enabling technology. AI capex cycle drives sticky multi-year revenue.

catalysts.name: Q1 FY27 Earnings
catalysts.description: Sep 9, 2026. Guided revenue $465-475M (+6-9% QoQ). Street watches 157% YoY growth continuation and hyperscaler customer expansion.

catalysts.name: Analyst Target Hikes Post-Beat
catalysts.description: Post Q4 beat: BofA $340, Stifel $350, Needham, Roth, Jefferies, Mizuho, Susquehanna, JPMorgan all raised targets. Multiple re-rating in progress as AI networking becomes critical infrastructure.

risks: Customer concentration risk — single hyperscaler (believed Microsoft) represents large portion of revenue; any contract pause = revenue cliff
Competition from Marvell Technology (MRVL) and Broadcom (AVGO) in AI networking silicon
120x P/E valuation — priced for perfection; any slowdown in hyperscaler AI capex triggers sharp derating
Stock has already run +218% in 12 months — much good news priced in; upside depends on continued beat-and-raise cadence

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed hawkish tilt (Jul 29 FOMC) pressures high-P/E semis; CRDO ~96x P/E is rate-sensitive despite structural AI demand.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Semiconductor components face some cost inflation but CRDO's custom silicon pricing power absorbs this
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI networking demand is structural and multi-year — independent of Fed rate decisions. Hyperscaler AI capex is the dominant driver.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — AI networking demand is structural, but CRDO's premium multiple makes it vulnerable to hawkish macro surprises (CPI Jul 14, FOMC Jul 29).
